data.exact_reserve_text: Overall, on an aggregate basis, a reserve release of GBP 8.8m net of reinsurance was made to prior year reserves during 2022 (2021 GBP 5.7m). The reserve release was primarily due to the favourable development across Property classes partially offset by adverse development on the Legal Indemnities class.
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a net prioryear release of GBP 8.8m (net of reinsurance) driven by favourable development in Property lines, partially offset by adverse development in Legal Indemnities. However, the gross claims development triangle indicates a small gross prioryear strengthening of approximately GBP 3.4m (driven by development on older years such as 2020 and offset by releases on 2018/2019), so gross and net movements diverge reflecting reinsurance effects.

The reserve release was primarily due to the favourable development across Property classes partially offset by adverse development on the Legal Indemnities class.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The report explicitly states a net prioryear release of GBP 8.8m (net of reinsurance). No explicit gross prioryear movement (gross insurance liabilities only) is stated in the movement note; therefore the gross prioryear movement was computed from the published GROSS claims development triangle (gross cumulative claims by underwriting year). That calculation yields a small gross strengthening (~GBP 3.421m). Net and gross directions differ due to reinsurance recoveries. Claims triangle and technical provisions reference RITC for 2017 and prior (reinsured away), but the triangle excludes 2017 and prior; used triangle as fallback per rules.
